title.zh-CN: 反复咯血与自幼湿疹 · 12岁男孩
title.en: Recurrent haemoptysis and lifelong eczema · boy aged 12

summary.zh-CN: 反复咯血伴长期皮肤及牙齿线索，需要将免疫缺陷与血管病变证据分别判断。
summary.en: Haemoptysis with longstanding skin and dental clues requires separate assessment of immune and vascular evidence.

provenance.citation: 刘金荣, 段晓岷, 郭爱新, 赵顺英, 江载芳. 高IgE综合征合并肺血管病变一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(09):692-693. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.09.012.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 联合皮肤、感染和乳牙史识别免疫缺陷。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate skin, infection and dental history to recognise immune deficiency.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分基因确证与血管影像推测。

feedback.zh-CN: 湿疹、化脓感染、乳牙潴留与高IgE有联系；血管证据另行判断。
feedback.en: Eczema, infection, retained teeth and IgE fit together; vascular evidence is assessed separately.

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释肺血管异常及综合征线索。

text.zh-CN: 没有发绀即证实血氧正常

text.zh-CN: 遗传支持STAT3相关HIES；血管瘘具体类型仍未确认

feedback.zh-CN: 不能将明确免疫诊断替代未完成的血管定位。
feedback.en: The immune diagnosis does not replace incomplete vascular localisation.

text.zh-CN: 基因结果证明一定是肺动静脉瘘
text.en: Genetics prove a pulmonary AV fistula

feedback.zh-CN: 基因不确定血管交通的解剖类型。
feedback.en: Genetics do not establish the anatomy of the connection.

text.zh-CN: 父母阴性即可否定患儿变异

feedback.en: A de novo variant is possible.

prompt.zh-CN: 暂时不再咯血时怎样安排后续？

need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

feedback.zh-CN: 既往较多咯血和未定血管病变需要持续计划。

text.zh-CN: 半年未咯血即可宣布病变消失

feedback.zh-CN: 症状间歇不等于解剖病变消失。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：联合皮肤、感染和乳牙史识别免疫缺陷。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：SpO₂、血管最终解剖、长期感染及出血结局。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Integrate skin, infection and dental history to recognise immune deficiency. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: SpO₂, definitive vascular anatomy and long-term infection/bleeding outcomes. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: STAT3相关高IgE综合征证据较强，伴疑似肺血管畸形，血管类型仍保留问号。
conclusion.en: Evidence supports STAT3-related hyper-IgE syndrome with suspected pulmonary vascular malformation of uncertain type.

keyReasoning.en: Integrate skin, infection and dental history to recognise immune deficiency.

keyReasoning.en: Distinguish genetic support from vascular imaging inference.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 保留未测氧合与未完成手术的信息边界。
keyReasoning.en: Retain uncertainty about unmeasured oxygenation and incomplete vascular assessment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 联合皮肤、感染和乳牙史识别免疫缺陷。
teachingPoints.en: Integrate skin, infection and dental history to recognise immune deficiency.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
